reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: New Hampshire
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Are eviction cases first heard in high court?
*/

/* =========================
   Scenario (facts)
   ========================= */

scenario_state(new_hampshire).
scenario_focus_year(2021).
scenario_case_type(eviction_case).

/* Helper predicate that succeeds when the entire factual statement (scenario) is satisfied. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(new_hampshire),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_case_type(eviction_case).

/* =========================
   Statute encoding (NH RSA 540:13 (2021))
   ========================= */

/* --- Court of initial return / initial forum ---
   NH Rev Stat  540:13 I (2021):
   "A writ of summons may be issued, returnable before a district court..."
*/
statute_nh_rsa_540_13_initial_return_court(2021, eviction_case, district_court).

/* --- Notice / appearance requirement (contest eviction) ---
   NH Rev Stat  540:13 II(a) (2021)
*/
statute_nh_rsa_540_13_contest_requires_appearance_by_return_day(2021, eviction_case, district_court).

/* --- No eviction unless ordered; default possible if no appearance ---
   NH Rev Stat  540:13 II(b) (2021)
*/
statute_nh_rsa_540_13_no_eviction_without_court_order(2021, eviction_case).
statute_nh_rsa_540_13_default_order_possible_if_no_appearance(2021, eviction_case).

/* --- Request sound recording at time of appearance ---
   NH Rev Stat  540:13 II(c) (2021)
*/
statute_nh_rsa_540_13_tenant_may_request_sound_recording_at_appearance(2021, eviction_case, district_court).

/* --- Appeal path and deadlines ---
   NH Rev Stat  540:13 II(d)(1)-(3) (2021)
*/
statute_nh_rsa_540_13_appeal_step(2021, eviction_case, step1_notice_intent_to_appeal, district_court, days_after_notice_of_decision(7)).
statute_nh_rsa_540_13_appeal_step(2021, eviction_case, step2_notice_of_appeal, supreme_court, days_after_notice_of_decision(30)).
statute_nh_rsa_540_13_appeal_step(2021, eviction_case, step3_pay_rent_as_due_pending_appeal, requirement, continuous_between(intent_to_appeal_and_final_disposition)).

/* --- Returnability timing from service ---
   NH Rev Stat  540:13 III (2021):
   "returnable 7 days from the date of service ... by the sheriff."
*/
statute_nh_rsa_540_13_writ_returnable_days_from_service(2021, eviction_case, 7).

/* --- Discovery right before merits hearing ---
   NH Rev Stat  540:13 IV (2021)
*/
statute_nh_rsa_540_13_discovery_right(2021, eviction_case, both_parties).

/* --- Hearing scheduling window if appearance filed ---
   NH Rev Stat  540:13 V (2021):
   hearing within 10 days after appearance filing (subject to discovery allowance),
   and notice mailed no fewer than 6 days prior.
*/
statute_nh_rsa_540_13_hearing_within_days_after_appearance(2021, eviction_case, 10).
statute_nh_rsa_540_13_hearing_notice_mailed_no_fewer_than_days_prior(2021, eviction_case, 6).

/* --- Default notice timing if tenant fails to file appearance or appear ---
   NH Rev Stat  540:13 V (2021):
   default notice mailed at least 3 days prior to issuance of writ of possession.
*/
statute_nh_rsa_540_13_default_notice_days_prior_to_writ_of_possession(2021, eviction_case, 3).

/* --- Written decision in contested hearing ---
   NH Rev Stat  540:13 VI (2021)
*/
statute_nh_rsa_540_13_contested_hearing_requires_written_decision(2021, eviction_case).

/* --- Nonpayment acceptance without creating new tenancy if written intention to proceed ---
   NH Rev Stat  540:13 VII (2021)
*/
statute_nh_rsa_540_13_nonpayment_accept_arrearage_without_new_tenancy_if_written_intent(2021, eviction_case).

/* =========================
   Legal reasoning helpers
   ========================= */

/* Define what counts as a "high court" for this question.
   (The statute expressly mentions appeal to the "supreme court"; we treat that as a high court.
    We also include "superior_court" as a higher-level court category, though RSA 540:13 does not
    place initial hearings there.)
*/
high_court(supreme_court).
high_court(superior_court).

/* Derive the first (initial) hearing/return court for the case type from the statute. */
legal_first_hearing_court(State, Year, CaseType, Court) :-
    State = new_hampshire,
    statute_nh_rsa_540_13_initial_return_court(Year, CaseType, Court).

/* Core question: is the case first heard in a high court? */
legal_first_heard_in_high_court(State, Year, CaseType) :-
    legal_first_hearing_court(State, Year, CaseType, Court),
    high_court(Court).

/* =========================
   Answer derivation
   ========================= */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    scenario_case_type(CaseType),
    legal_first_heard_in_high_court(State, Year, CaseType),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

/* =========================
   Main entrypoint
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Are eviction cases first heard in high court?
